subjects.description: A solid structural wall that terminates the alpine mountain road, its flat vertical face entirely covered by a hyper-realistic trompe-l'oeil mural depicting an open road stretching toward a distant horizon beneath a clear blue sky
subjects.appearance_details: The painted mural shows asphalt lane markings receding to a vanishing point, soft cumulus clouds, and a graduated blue sky; a warm late-afternoon cast and subtle brush sheen, a passing cloud shadow drifting across the paint, and the faint seam where the mural meets adjacent structures, reveal it is a flat painted surface
subjects.relationship: It is the terminal obstacle the ego vehicle must recognize and stop before; it deceptively mimics a continuation of the street
subjects.location: center frame, filling the far end of the street
subjects.orientation: facing directly toward the camera/ego vehicle
subjects.action: Standing as a fixed barrier closing off the road
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger in frame as the ego vehicle approaches, then stabilizes as the vehicle stops.

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, an autonomous passenger car, seen only through its forward-facing point of view as it travels down the warm-lit alpine mountain road
subjects.appearance_details: Implied by the dashboard-level ego perspective; smooth motion suggests a modern sedan with advanced driver-assistance sensors
subjects.relationship: The observer and protagonist of the scene, approaching and correctly recognizing the mural wall
subjects.orientation: facing forward down the street toward the wall
subjects.pose: moving forward then decelerating to a halt
subjects.action: Driving down the street, then braking to a smooth controlled stop before the wall
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from steady forward motion to deceleration to a complete, sustained stop.

background_setting: An alpine mountain road in late afternoon, winding through rolling hills clad in autumn foliage with pine stands, chalet-style houses and distant peaks. The dry asphalt runs straight ahead on this stretch with faded lane markings, framed by golden and rust-colored trees. The road dead-ends at a solid structural wall whose surface bears a hyper-realistic mural of an open road and clear sky, creating an optical illusion of the road continuing toward the mountains. No traffic signs of any kind are present anywhere in the scene.

lighting.conditions: Warm late-afternoon sun with partly cloudy sky
lighting.direction: Low warm side light from the west, raking across the hills
lighting.shadows: Long side shadows with drifting soft-edged cloud shadows moving across the road
lighting.illumination_effect: Warm raking light gilds the autumn foliage while cloud shadows drift over the scene; the painted mural catches a warm afternoon cast, its fixed blue sky slightly warmer than the real partly-cloudy sky, subtle brush sheen betraying the flat surface

aesthetics.composition: Centered one-point perspective with the mountain road receding toward the mural wall at the vanishing point; autumn hillsides and peaks frame the road
aesthetics.color_scheme: Golden and rust autumn foliage, deep pine green, warm asphalt and the painted mural's warm-lit blue
aesthetics.patterns: Layered autumn hillsides and rhythmic lane markings

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.focus: The mural wall and the full length of the street ahead

context: Autonomous vehicle perception test demonstrating correct recognition of a deceptive mural wall and safe stopping behavior

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels steadily forward down the alpine mountain road toward the mural wall at the far end.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop before the wall and remains stationary, holding the view of the mural under warm late-afternoon light; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

segments.description: Ego vehicle drives forward down the straight stretch of alpine road, the mural wall growing larger ahead while autumn foliage and chalets pass on either side under drifting cloud shadow.
segments.key_changes: Steady approach; wall increases in apparent size in warm side light.
segments.camera: Forward tracking motion at constant speed, eye-level.

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The vehicle is fully stopped before the wall and remains stationary, holding a steady view of the trompe-l'oeil mural in warm afternoon light. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle travels steadily forward down the alpine mountain road toward the mural wall at the far end. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient alpine afternoon sounds: the low hum of the vehicle's electric motor and tires on dry asphalt, wind through pines, distant birdsong and mountain stillness. As the vehicle slows, a soft regenerative braking whir is audible, followed by the quiet of the stationary vehicle. No speech or music.
